_readme: Files that get COPIED into other packages, not imported. This file says which files go where.
`fhevm-npm sync vendored` writes the copies; `--check` fails if a copy drifted.
Why copy at all: a published package cannot depend on a private workspace member. Packages that are
never published skip the copy and import @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev/<file>.ts instead.
Two of these files are generated, so regenerate before syncing (`make generate` does both, in order):
cleartext-config.ts  <- fhevm-npm generate cleartext-config, from sdk/cleartext-config.json
fhevm-chains.ts      <- fhevm-npm generate chain-constants, from sdk/fhevm-chains.config.json
One entry, one set of files: `to` lists every directory that gets that exact copy.

destinations.note: The adapter interfaces. Both live generations get the same copy, and public.ts re-exports it instead of declaring the types.
The TypeScript form of sdk/cleartext-config.json, compiled into the published package. Both live generations get the same copy.
Takes the ethers adapter. No copy of ethereumLibTypes.ts: this package already depends on @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext, so the type import is rewritten to point there.
Takes the viem adapter instead (hardhat 3 recommends viem), with the same type-import rewrite as the v2 one.
